patch_description: The current code fuses an independent forward and backward Kalman filter with heuristic velocity-confidence weights. Replace this with a proper Rauch-Tung-Striebel (RTS) smoother: store the filtered states and covariances from the forward pass, then run the true backward recursion using the smoother gain G = P_f F' P_pred^{-1}, where P_pred is the *predicted* (prior) covariance at each step. The RTS smoother is the minimum-variance fixed-interval estimate for the linear-Gaussian model, so it should reduce noise and false reversals further while keeping zero phase, at the same O(n) cost. Also store predicted covariances during the forward pass so the backward recursion is exact. The adaptive measurement-noise heuristic is kept, which makes this an adaptive RTS smoother. Output slicing and length contract remain unchanged.
